name: ntr_top_mix
xsql:
Select 
    -- ROW 1
    Max(Case When rn = 1 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_1_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 1 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_1_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 1 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_1_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 1 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_1_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 1 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_1_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 1 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_1_others_pct,
    
    -- ROW 2
    Max(Case When rn = 2 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_2_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 2 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_2_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 2 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_2_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 2 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_2_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 2 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_2_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 2 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_2_others_pct,
    
    -- ROW 3
    Max(Case When rn = 3 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_3_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 3 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_3_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 3 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_3_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 3 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_3_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 3 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_3_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 3 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_3_others_pct,
    
    -- ROW 4
    Max(Case When rn = 4 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_4_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 4 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_4_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 4 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_4_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 4 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_4_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 4 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_4_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 4 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_4_others_pct,
    
    -- ROW 5
    Max(Case When rn = 5 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_5_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 5 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_5_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 5 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_5_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 5 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_5_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 5 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_5_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 5 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_5_others_pct,

    -- ROW 6
    Max(Case When rn = 6 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_6_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 6 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_6_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 6 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_6_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 6 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_6_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 6 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_6_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 6 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_6_others_pct,

    -- ROW 7
    Max(Case When rn = 7 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_7_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 7 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_7_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 7 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_7_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 7 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_7_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 7 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_7_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 7 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_7_others_pct,

    -- ROW 8
    Max(Case When rn = 8 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_8_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 8 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_8_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 8 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_8_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 8 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_8_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 8 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_8_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 8 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_8_others_pct,

    -- ROW 9
    Max(Case When rn = 9 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_9_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_9_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_9_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_9_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_9_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 9 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_9_others_pct,

    -- ROW 10
    Max(Case When rn = 10 Then ASR_Name End) as mix_10_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Total_Payout End), 0), '#,###'), '0') as mix_10_payout,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Bar_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_10_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Vol_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_10_vol_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Pts_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_10_pts_pct,
    Cast(Max(Case When rn = 10 Then Others_Pct End) as decimal(10,1)) as mix_10_others_pct

From (
    Select 
        ASR_Name,
        Total_Payout,
        (Total_Payout * 100.0 / Case When Max_Total = 0 Then 1 Else Max_Total End) as Bar_Pct,
        (Vol_Payout * 100.0 / Case When Total_Payout = 0 Then 1 Else Total_Payout End) as Vol_Pct,
        (Pts_Payout * 100.0 / Case When Total_Payout = 0 Then 1 Else Total_Payout End) as Pts_Pct,
        (Others_Payout * 100.0 / Case When Total_Payout = 0 Then 1 Else Total_Payout End) as Others_Pct,
        rn
    From (
        Select 
            ASR_Name,
            Total_Payout,
            Vol_Payout,
            Pts_Payout,
            Others_Payout,
            Max(Total_Payout) Over () as Max_Total,
            ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order By Total_Payout DESC) as rn
        From (
            Select 
                ASR_Name,
                Sum(amount) As Total_Payout,
                Sum(Case When sub_category = 'Initial Patients' Then amount Else 0 End) As Vol_Payout,
                Sum(Case When sub_category = 'Follow On Patients' Then amount Else 0 End) As Pts_Payout,
                Sum(Case When sub_category = 'Others' Then amount Else 0 End) As Others_Payout
            From (
                Select 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN IndexOf(pa_active.participant_name, '(') > 0 THEN SubString(pa_active.participant_name, 0, IndexOf(pa_active.participant_name, '(')) 
                        ELSE pa_active.participant_name 
                    END As ASR_Name,
                    p.amount,
                    Case 
                        When m.sub_category IS NULL Then tm.sub_category
                        Else m.sub_category
                    End As sub_category
                From xactly.xc_payment p
                
                /* Inlined Title Mapping */
                Inner Join (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                        pta.title_name AS title
                    FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                        ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                        ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                        AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                        AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                        ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
                    WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                ) title On p.participant_id = title.master_participant_id
                
                /* Inlined Territory Mapping & Region Filtering */
                Inner Join (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                        pa_active.territory AS territory,
                        pa_active.region AS region,
                        pa_active.name AS participant_name
                    FROM xactly.xc_period per 
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
                        ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                    INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
                        ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
                        AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                        AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
                    WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                ) pa_active On p.participant_id = pa_active.master_participant_id
                
                Inner Join NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
                    On p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
                    And title.title = m.title
                    And m.category = 'ONC'
                Left Join NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
                    On pa_active.territory = tm.territory 
                    
                Where p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
                  And p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
                  
                  -- Region Dashboard Filter
                  And ('ALL' IN (:p_region) OR pa_active.region IN (:p_region))
                  
                  And p.earning_group_name IN (
                      Select earning_group 
                      From NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING 
                      Where category = 'ONC'
                  )

            ) raw_data
            Group By ASR_Name
        ) agg_data
    ) windowed_data
) final_data;
